text: One ruler of this dynasty almost provoked a battle with the USS Constitution after he imprisoned the missionary Dominique Lefevre. Another ruler of this dynasty was declared insane and succeeded by his seven year-old son, who would later be exiled to Reunion and then serve as a radio officer on the destroyer Leopard. Another ruler of this dynasty lost a war that began with the decapitation of the Spanish bishop Jose Maria Diaz and had to cede his country's southernmost provinces. The family that founded this dynasty fought a long series of wars with the Trinh family and gained full control after the Tay Son revolt was crushed by Gia Long. The last ruler of this dynasty was known as the 'Playboy Emperor' and in 1955 was removed by Ngo Dinh Diem. For 10 points name this dynasty that included Bao Dai and was Vietnam's last.
